pages.text: Every Bee Mastery bee produces its own comb, and every comb centrifuges down into three things: a nugget of its metal, honey, and a chance of propolis. Reinforced combs are the most generous of the bunch, so that's the line to start with.

Nuggets compress into ingots, ingots into sticks, and sticks craft into frames and tools with beeswax. That whole chain - comb to nugget to ingot to stick - is the backbone of every tier in this book.

pages.title: Catching Wild Bees
pages.text: A Scoop lets you catch a wild vanilla bee and turn it into a Forestry drone, which you can then breed into the tandem line below.
